license.notes: Zoo 1.13.0. The convenience store's island snack gondola, from the walker's store references (docs/SET_DRESSING_REFERENCES.md 2026-09-15: 'gondola shelving, four or five shelves of chip bags faced out, end caps stacked with more chips'). A dark kick, a pegboard spine, steel uprights at every bay and end panels, a top rail; per face and bay, shelves up the height with white price strips; chip bags faced out on every shelf -- each a real bag (prims.pillow stood on its back: a puffed front, flat sides), its front printed from one image of invented Delco snack brands (core/snack_brands.py, denylisted against the Pennsylvania makers first), set in the m5x7 pixel face; end caps at both ends of a run 2.2 m or longer. Two submissions whatever the length: painted steel with colour in the Wear vertex colour, and the bags on one painted image. Both long faces are shopped; the +Y face and +X end cap are the -Y ones turned half round. Collision is the slot's box. 1.40.0: the -Y face stays chips; the +Y face is sections a bay each -- YUMMYJAWNS snack-cake cartons (one flavour a shelf), fruit snacks, lunch kits, bagged candy -- every product on the same one image. 1.133.0: form 'grocery' -- a supermarket's gondola. Each face sells one category of core/grocery_brands.py, the names the grocery aisle markers print; the variant is the gondola's line in its store, so the faces toward the lanes either side sell what their markers say (snack_gondola_forms.grocery_faces). Cartons, stacked hexagonal cans, jars, bottles and jugs, bags; its own painted image. module_variants 4 -> 12, a line a pair of the markers' 24 categories. budgets.tris_lod0 22000 -> 48000, the grocery form's ceiling (46,116 at 14 x 1.5 x 2.2); the snack form keeps 22,000 in its test (SNACK_TRIS_BUDGET).
